header.description: An RFC4122 UID used as a correlation id.
An RFC4122 UID used as a correlation id.

query.description:
(Required) Indicates the type of POI Number:
NAT: National Id
IQA: Iqama
GCC: GCC Countries Id
BORD: Border Number

(Required) Indicates the person's employment sector.
Gov: Data will be retrived from Masdr Government Salary Certificate (NCGR)
Non-Gov: Data will be retrived from Masdr Private Salary Certificate (GOSI)
Semi-Gov: Data will be retrived from Masdr Government Salary Certificate (NCGR) & if no records were found, Data will be retrived from Masdr Private Salary Certificate (GOSI)
Employee Birth Date. (Required in case of Gov and Semi-Gov sector, accept birthDate in Hijri or birthDate in Gregorian)
Birth Date Type (Required in case of Gov and Semi-Gov sector)
Pay Month. (Required in case of Gov and Semi-Gov sector, accept date in Hijri or Gregorian)
PayMonth Date type. (Required in case of Gov and Semi-Gov sector)
